learning_outcomes.text: Be aware of the advantages and challenges of using and developing AI based systems and models, in particular search algorithms, knowledge representation and reasoning, approaches for adaptive systems, and machine learning
Be capable of identifying the requirements of the systems and models to create
Be capable of choosing the approaches more suited to the LO2 requirements
Mastering and usage of the approaches presented in the course for system development and world modelling

syllabus_topics: Fundamental notions of AI with emphasis on the search-based approach
Search algorithms: depth first and breadth first, A*
The basics of machine learning: supervised, reinforcement learning and unsupervised learning
Multilayer feedforward neural networks with backpropagation
Fundamental notions relating to knowledge, representation and the architecture of knowledge-based systems
First-order predicate logic: representation and deduction
Declarative knowledge represented in Logic Programming
Rule Systems based on Fuzzy Logic
assessment_rules: For continuous assessment, a minimum grade of 8.5 is required in each test and a minimum grade of 9.5 in each project. The final grade for projects will be individualized based on performance in a practical assessment during an oral presentation. To access tests and exams, all related Moodle activities must be completed.
